query: INSERT INTO central.execution_command_receipts (id, workspace_id, command_scope, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, principal_id, capability, expected_version_digest, result_reference, result_payload, created_at, expires_at, eligible_after) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, '{}'::jsonb, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp() + interval '7 days', clock_timestamp() + interval '90 days') ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, command_scope, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
